reviews.title: Believe Every One Of These Awful Reviews
reviews.text: Mistakes happen. Flights get delayed and luggage sometimes misses a connection…even when passengers make it. What matters is how the issue is fixed. In the case of Brussels Air, they make every possible effort to make the already challenging situation worse. Much, much worse. Countless messages were ignored. Phone calls that did connect led to answers that were outright lies, several hang-ups, and twice when I got someone to escalate my call to a supervisor, I was transferred to unanswered lines with no voicemail. Our luggage was delivered four days into our vacation. We submitted receipts for the clothes and toiletries we needed to purchase. We literally bought things on a day-by-day basis to keep costs down, knowing that we wouldn’t be fully compensated. They sent us a letter that they would agree to pay an amount that did not even cover the toiletries that we had to buy. We responded that it was an unacceptable number, and asked them to reconsider. They never replied and just sent the check. They have continued to ignore emails, texts and voicemails. Oh, and our flights were on time, but the planes were filthy and the crews were hostile and rude. They charge for bottled water. Sounds great, right? Believe me when I tell you that I’ve had my share of issues with airlines, and I have never been moved to write a review like this. This company is a joke, and you’re better off walking. Avoid at all costs.
reviews.author: mbaNYC

reviews.title: Do Not Expect Any Refund
reviews.text: We booked and paid for exit row seats. At check in we had been separated and moved to standard seats. Brussels Airline did not automatically refund our seat reservation fee. The Airline did not respond to complaints (repeated three times). Customers Services simply refuse to address anything and direct you to the on line complaints system where you receive an automated reference number which, after five weeks is still not even replied to. Personally I doubt this airlines honesty, integrity and interest in their customers and I will actively avoid Brussels Airlines in future. If Brussels Airlines want to check this the complaint reference is 2306-SN-00161
reviews.author: Ian D

reviews.title: Worst airline of the Lufthansa group
reviews.text: Brussel airlines is the worst of the Lufthansa group airlines based on my experience. They do not even offer water which is normally free on Austrian, Lufthansa, and Swiss. Luggage policy at copenhagen was also wierd veryone had to check in their luggage resulting in empty luggage racks in the airplane. On my flight also my seatpocket was broken.
reviews.author: Patrick K

reviews.title: Ms
reviews.text: My first trip back home alone from UK,i booked Brussels Airlines for my journey. All staff were so helpful,the meals were great compared to what I expected the fact that I had paid economy class.I felt safe throughout the whole journey. No trouble,no delays all was perfect. 👌 Good service needs to be appreciated.
reviews.author: Rynee K

reviews.title: Smooth + perfect customer service
reviews.text: Easy boarding experience no fuss from staff, absolutely amazing. Straightforward policies on baggage as well so you know exactly what you can take. Return flight got cancelled unfortunately for almost 24 hours but we couldn't wish for better service. We were ready to pay for everything then claim money back only to find out it's all been taken care off (transfer from airport to the hotel, dinner, breakfast and taxi back to the airport) by the airline without us having to ask for a single thing. If I could give 6* I would! Thank you
reviews.author: Ivana S

reviews.title: Aggressive Attendants
reviews.text: Flew to Berlin from Brussels, first the flight was delayed 40 minutes, then the flight attendants tried to rush everyone on the plane. We had 2 tickets and only one carry on and a hand bag, due to the delay attendants were just putting bags anywhere and being rude about it. We were told to put all our bags on the floor or risk being late. One female attendant snatched the bag from my wife’s hands and thee it on the floor. Not risking any delays or thrown off the flight, we just sat there and took her abuse. NEVER flying Brussels Air ever again.
reviews.author: Sunny B

reviews.title: Cancelled my return flight
reviews.text: Thieves is an appropriate word. They cancelled my return ticket after I missed my 1st flight. They did not ask for my permission, and when I called they used their sales conditions to argue that I needed to let them know without 3 hours of missing my flight, which I unfortunately did after 4 hours. Apparently that's enough to force you to rebook the exact same ticket. Customer service did not even care nor apologized. Oh, and they increased the price of the return ticket several times while I was trying to book it, it went from 180€ to 270€ in less than 30 minutes. Thieves.
reviews.author: Lily

reviews.title: Cabin staff
reviews.text: It was a full Airbus 319 and I was fortunate enough to be in business class. On this flight there was no difference in seating but it was a short flight and so a small meal was made avaialable. A simple sadal with turkey and shaved cheese and a nive seeded roll and 2 pieces of Belgian chocolates. The Cabin chief Denis Croon was extremely helpful and friendly and full of humor. I was very impressed with his language skills. He, knew, so farf as I coud tell 4 languages. I'm not a fan of the Airbus 319, strikes me as a bit of a rattlebox but the servies was wonderful.
reviews.author: Kirk W

reviews.title: You will never get compensation money
reviews.text: My flight from Copenhagen to Brussels was delayed and i arrived 5 later than the expected arrival time. At the gate i was told that there was a problem at Brussel's airport but when i asked for compensation money, which i was entitled to, I was told that the problem was departure delays at Copenhagen airport. This was not true because this was the only delayed flight around that time. The company uses any excuse not to pay compensation money and we are helpless because we can not prove the contrary.
reviews.author: anasancho10

reviews.title: Flight overbooked. No refund and no service. An absolut disgrace!
reviews.text: No refund and compensation for an overbooked flight. Need to sue. On the 05.12.2022 brussels airlines (as often the case) overbooked the flight. Ans now they refuse to pay back the money. They owe me about 1000 euro. Its really os a frdulant company. Know many of such stories.
reviews.author: J s

reviews.title: The Wicked Policies of Brussel Airlines
reviews.text: I bought a flight from Brussels back in March to travel in December. On the advert at the point of sale the criteria was that I could change my booking for £130. 2 weeks before me flying out and required to change the booking. Brussels used tactics such as, not answering the phone, putting me on hold for hours. disconnecting the call. I had asked Brussels to change the booking and come back with a price for the rebooking. it would have ben cheaper to buy another ticket and within the on peak times. I tried to book an open ticket, they said that they did not sell them despite them giving me a quote for an open ticket and the telephonist did not get back to me. Brussels ended up using all the time of me constantly calling them and never having an answer, which is another tactic they have. Please don't use this airline. They don't care about their customers. They even kept my money for the seats that I had booked and when queried they gave their 200 word legislation of how they can keep my money policy on basically how they can keep my money. Do Brussel really want people to read all of their policies prior to them booking. They stole from me £565 even though I wanted to buy another ticket. I ended up up not even travelling.
reviews.author: Jay

reviews.title: False advertising DANGER
reviews.text: Flying with my wife to AMS Booked Bus class online Website advertises 24 Cancel BEFORE the 24 hours decided to cancel Airline refused to refund money Phone agents would not address issue as it was an online purchase Dispute ensued with Credit Card company Airline insisted they were right Finally with all the data presented credit card company backed me and the money was refunded. This was after 4.5 months of dispute LESSON Take screenshots of important parts of the transaction with date and time. this saved me.
reviews.author: Dave G

reviews.title: extremely Poor costumer service attitude
reviews.text: Flight was late 30 min in Brussel , then rush shuffle passenger to plane , absolutely irresponsible , without respect to passenger boarding staff , insisted to check in my cabin suitcase to check in as the plane is full( which they say always, i saw there are plenty space on cabins luggage later)and i am in emergency seat ! i kept resisted to do that ! one of boarding guys came ,grab my suitcase then put the tags on my passport and send me away , no words or whatsoever !!! It was shocking and i was panic what was just happened !!! i had medication on my suitcase which it must be with me all the time but its clear as crystal they dont care about your comfort and respect . It has been absolutely terrible experience for International airline such as Brussel airline and down grade the international reputation especially in Brussel ( the heart of the airline) I need formal apology and compensation from the airline which it caused the nightmare and humiliation for me as a passenger ,paying the ticket , then facing disrespect.
reviews.author: James A

reviews.title: Good for European connections
reviews.text: This is a summary of several flights over a couple of weeks. Brussels airlines is okay, without much more. Compared to other airlines, like TAP or Austrian, it's just that bit less, showing that BA depends on the policies of the big brother, considering it rather as a low-cost daughter. Friendly crew, clean and efficient, yes for sure! And with my SA Gold level I won't complain about practicalities!
reviews.author: Philip P

reviews.title: Terrible
reviews.text: I can tell you, this is the worst flying experience of my life. If you have children, I highly recommend going to Lufthansa or Austrian Airlines. Or Aegian. Anything!
reviews.author: Mary R

reviews.title: TERRIBLE SERVICE
reviews.text: I traveled with this airline on 01/03/2023. August made sure I paid extra for an exit seat. This is because I require extra leg room for flight for the flight from Brussels to Entebbe. This is due to health and comfort reasons. Especially on long haul flights. I contacted customer service before my flight and they confirmed I was going to get an exit seat. They even allocated a seat number to me. I was amazed when I got on board and the allocated seat was not an exit seat as promised. Crew on board stated that the exit seats were all occupied. I was baffled. I had to go to thier Kampala office to make sure this was not repeated on the return leg. Since my return I have been chasing a refund for an unfulfilled service. After all the back and forth with calls and submitting requested evidence Brussels airlines decided I was not entitled to a refund because I only paid the flights between Brussels and Entebbe rather than the full journey between London and Entebbe. This is ridiculous. Why do you make it possible to make payment for a service that you say you do not deliver. This is scandalous. I am very annoyed. Secondly, I discovered my suitcase was torn when I arrived Entebbe. I was asked by airline officials to report it to their Kampala office which I did. They took possession of the suitcase promising to sort it out. All they did was put a big patch on the torn area and return the suitcase to me. I can no longer use it for journeys. How can you damage my property and not return it the way it was before the damage? I would not recommend this airline to anyone.
reviews.author: SML

reviews.title: Horrible staff don’t fly with them!
reviews.text: Really rude airline at boarding gates. Shouting, arrogance and really ignorant. Will not fly with them again.
reviews.author: sorcha h

reviews.title: bad customer service and changes of expansive flight to a cheaper flight without any compensation
reviews.text: The flight was on July 2022. I ordered direct flight, and only 5 hours before the flight they cancelled my flight and replace it with one connection flight. I paid a lot of money so the flight will be direct one, and they haven't gave me any compensation for the replacement with cheaper flight (because of the connection). I try to make a contact with their customer service since August 2022 and they like 3 month later, an answer that they asked me for more detail. I send them the details and they haven't answer me yet. It was almost a year ago!!!!
reviews.author: Anna Anna123456

reviews.title: Great service, punctual, comfortable
reviews.text: We were an hour late leaving but that's pretty usual these days. Seats were comfortable, entertainment system was good. Service was excellent, food was decent. No issues with the flight overall.
reviews.author: Marija G

reviews.title: dissapointed
reviews.text: its very dissapointing that brussels is a big and trust worthy airline but it still looses peoples bags this honestly shouldnt be happenning my mom is the one who flew with brussels she came back to paris today on arrival she waited normally for her bag as others were waiting too. only to end up waiting for more than one hour and eventually beeing told her bag isnt there along with over 15-20 other peoples bags are missing...... Do better brussels!!!!
reviews.author: nelly n

reviews.title: Never received my golf bag
reviews.text: I was extremely disappointed by their service.. I am a professional golfer and was traveling for a tournament in Amsterdam via Brussels. My bag didn’t arrive with me and they said it will arrive the next day. I called to see if it had arrived and they said my bag was in Brussels so I drove 2 HOURS to go get it. Turns out it wasn’t there. I never received my bag the entire week, a week later when I arrived back at Madrid Barajas airport, my golf bag was abandoned on one of the belts. I emailed customer service about the damage they have caused but they stopped replying after a while AND I never received an apology. Truly disappointing.
reviews.author: Amanda W

reviews.title: Instant home feeling from boarding, in-flight service with a smile, good food and beverages, helpful
reviews.text: The smile and spontaneity of the cabin crew immediately creates a feeling of coming home and tranquility. Fortunately, as the flight was slightly delayed and the travellers were therefore slightly displeased. The boarding process was somewhat chaotic i.e. the signs and rows with business class and economy were switched (so people had to line up again in another row) and a translation error and pronunciation by the staff at the gate caused confusion between the "pre" boarding group (e.g. people with young children and special assistance) and "boarding group 3". Boarding itself - once off to a good start - went quickly (the flight was not fully booked). Some rows were free and in business class the seats in the middle row were free (pleasant for couples). Business saver is worth the price (fast track so you save time, access to the Lufthansa lounge at Athens airport with excellent food and drinks, priority boarding and baggage allowance, extra baggage allowed in the cabin). Excellent service during the flight. The cabin crew is super friendly and helpful. Several people had a connection flight in Brussels and were reassured they could make it, if necessary with extra help and accelerated disembarkation once they arrived in Brussels at the airport. Tasty meal (vegetarian on Thursday) and extensive choice of drinks. Tasty snacks savory and sweet. A sweet and authentic touch are the Belgian pralines for dessert. We highly recommend this airline and will continue to use their services in the future.
reviews.author: Luxury Journey

reviews.title: Comfortable travel, punctual, excellent service, communicative, authentically Belgian
reviews.text: Punctual. Warm welcome. Excellent in-flight service with a smile. Comfortable seats and ample legroom. An added value is that you get an extra seat (free) in the middle in business class (we booked as a couple). The upgrade to business saver is worth it because of the fast track, lounge access (if open; we prefer a morning flight and the lounge at Brussels Airport opens at 5.30AM), extra baggage you can take into the cabin (two carry-ons and one personal item per person plus 2 x 32kg check-in baggage per person); priority baggage also included. Large overhead bins. The flight from Brussels to Athens was in the morning: the breakfast is tasty, strong coffee, wide choice of tea, enough sandwiches and sweets. An extra touch are the authentic Belgian biscuits that you get as a snack and can keep as a promotional gift or thank you to the staff in your accommodation. We have been flying with this airline for years and can highly recommend it. We will definitely use their services again in the future.
reviews.author: Luxury Journey

reviews.title: No respons after our luggages never showed up
reviews.text: After a trip to portugal our luggage ended up in Toulouse. We did not get our luggage back until we came home. We have been trying to get in contact about refusion, but it is impossiple. no response for 5 month. Horrible
reviews.author: Rune Holst N

reviews.title: Luggage delays and poor service
reviews.text: Poor service. Wrong information. Lack of empathy with passengers. Expensive tickets which do not correspond to the service quality nor professionalism.
reviews.author: Sonia V.M.

reviews.title: Bureaucratic Nightmare. Don’t fly with them.
reviews.text: This airline had an extremely long line at check in because they weigh EVERYTHING. Even my purse! We had an extra bag that we needed to pay for. We had to go to another counter to pay for it because they couldn’t accept extra baggage payment there. Then we had to bring that bag back after paying for it at another counter. This is a prime example of European bureaucracy. Nightmare. Plan ahead. You will need at least an 1 1/2 hours to get rid of your checked bags.
reviews.author: likeitnice1968

reviews.title: Absolutely garbage
reviews.text: Seat space is ridiculous for any one over 5" 5. I booked a seat thinking it was an extra legroom seat but was mistaken, this seat cost me 30 dollars, I contacted an online agent to be kept on hold for 20 minutes all to be told the ancillary purchases I.e seat purchases are non refundable and cannot be amended, so basically I'd have to repurchase another seat at full price instead of having the extra 35 dollars charged to me for 65 dollor extra legroom seat. I'm 6" 6 and literally cannot sit in a regular seat and also told the agent this but to my surprise she cancels the chat and refuses to assist me further worst airline for customer services and to add insult my departure flight was 1 hour late departing but is there any good will gesture for this of course not, fly BA where at least you get good customer service and better leg space
reviews.author: S P

reviews.title: Worst customer service ever
reviews.text: Called the customer service, the staff was very unfriendly and arrogant insisting she couldn't understand anything I was saying, but I was just telling her the booking reference and my name. I have been living in the UK for four years and communicating with people from different countries in English everyday and never did anyone say they cannot understand me because of my accent. At last she refused to answer any of my questions and kept saying "I cannot understand because you have accent" and insisted I should change the language choice. I called service centres of other flight companies several times before and this never happened.
reviews.author: Ciel

reviews.title: No, thank you Brussels airlines - never again
reviews.text: Waiting in 7 h for connecting flight home to OSL. Asking for water, no you must pay! Spending a lot of Euros on the airport, who cares. A short check on the passenger list and the stuarts will understand that there are "long distance customers" that's it. No not with Brussels Airlines! Sorry
reviews.author: axels

reviews.title: Some good points but so much room for improvement
reviews.text: I was flying to Brussels from Singapore. Without a direct flight, I chose this connecting flight from Milan as I had never flown Brussels Airlines before. While it wasn't the airline's fault, public announcements at Milan Malpensa were far too soft, making it difficult to figure out when my boarding group was called. This was a full flight and the boarding process was rather slow - a common experience these days due to many passengers wanting to load their carry-on luggage in the overhead bins. Once seated, the flight attendants kept a sharp look-out that safety measures were adhered to prior to take-off - certainly a good sign. There was no complimentary beverage offering (all items, including water, needed to be purchased) - again, an increasingly common feature on flights worldwide. Furthermore, the Airbus A319 did not have seat-back inflight entertainment systems. So while uneventful, the flight was, thankfully, only just over an hour long. Overall, a flight experience that could improve with just a few minor changes here and there. For the moment, just don't get your expectations up and you won't be disappointed.
reviews.author: ianwyj

reviews.title: Fly with this company
reviews.text: Very good fly...I really like to fly with this company and will in the future . Clean and comfortable .will fly with this company
reviews.author: Victoria P

reviews.title: AWFUL AND TIRING! LUGGAGE DAMAGED AND NOT PAYED BACK
reviews.text: awful experience! You travel for work, paying lots of money and that's what you get: a damaged luggae, time loss (at the airport and later to solve it) and I have been dealing with this issues since 2 weeks and I m really tired considering that my baggage has been damaged by you and was not my choice to board it, but yours, telling the passengers, just 10 minutes earlier, that due to lack of space (with such a big company I mean), we were forced to board the handluggages. You even called by groups, so mine was the last one and I was obliged to board it. I told the hostess that in all pèossibole ways that I was afraid they could damage it, considering how they treat the suitcases. Furthermore, instead of giving it back by the plane, it was direclty delivered on the belt and completely damaged. (plus th loss of ime going there ands waiting for it- otherwise if i had wanted it, I would have booked a luggage to board!). I went to the desk in milan Linate, the filled the form which was ONLY IN ENGLISH, which she could not, and instead of writing 8 months she ticked 8 years. BEYOND THE DAMAGE THE MOCKERY: a present, cause it wa a present form last year for my birthday, and I have used it twice, so was completely new, as you can see from the pictures: the only damages are from the flight from BRUSSEL on 2nd march. I want my money back as the attendants said it would have happened and I am tired to chase everyone to have something which is owed and must be repaid. So, as I have been told at the airport that day, please provide to what you need to do. You dont convince people to fly with you in this way and just to provide with a terrible review. I already have a case opeend with DOLFI 1920, who suggested me to talk directly with you.
reviews.author: Ellie

reviews.title: The WORST customer service
reviews.text: On February 18, 2023 returning from Rwanda to the US, our flight canceled due to engine failure. We were told to deplane and they would help us. That couldn't have been further from the truth. There was absolutely no help from any customer service agent. We were told we had to leave the airport so we had to find a cab to take us to a hotel for the night. The airline was supposed to rebook us for the next day and they messed that up as well so we had to fix their error in order to get booked and return home. We purchased travel insurance in case of any additional expenses that we incurred due to flight interruption. We have reached out to Brussels Airlines several time to get documentation of the flight cancelling so we can be reimbursed. Brussels Airlines has refused to help me when I call and have told me to contact their online group. I have emailed them twice with no response. I have never come across such incompetence from a customer service industry.
reviews.author: Connie H

reviews.title: Brussels Airlines Star Alliance Extra Charges
reviews.text: If you book through United for a multi-leg trip don't use Brussels Airlines. One leg with United, One leg with Brussels Airlines, one leg with Air Canada. Got free set selection at booking with 1 free checked in bag and 1 free carryon bag. No problem with United or Air Canada. Brussels Airlines required me to pay for seats!!!! In the fine print at the bottom of an itinerary they emailed me, Brussels Airlines stated that I would have to pay $200 to check in a bag, and could only have a carry on the size of a small back pack. When I tried to clear this up, Brussels Airlines stated that I would have to talk with United. And United stated that I would have to talk with Brussels Airlines. After not taking no for an answer United put in touch with Micheal at Brussels Airlines. Who sent me a receipt email for the seats I paid for!!! Michael did say that once United took the bags they would have to be sent through? He said that a Supervisor would call me back! NOT yet!!!
reviews.author: Rennata Levy L

reviews.title: Despicable customer service
reviews.text: They cancelled flight the day itself because they were too greedy to pay their pilots a decent wage. They refused to rebook, refused to refund the full amount. Refuses to abide by the European rules. Customer care is absolutely non-existent. Worst company I have ever had to deal with, completely despicable Don't think for one second that this airline is premium, it is the cheapest, greedy customer service that exists. Also, flights are trash and barely any leg room. You're more comfortable in a porta-potty
reviews.author: joeny695

reviews.title: Appallingly bad advice cost me a fortune!
reviews.text: I booked a ticket from London to Mexico City, transiting through Houston USA, called Brussels airline twice to ask whether there were any Covid requirements to pass through US. They assured me there were none, even after pressing them them on the US transit question . Got to Heathrow and wasn’t even allowed to check in to the Houston flight without proof of vaccination. Lost £550 on the original ticket and had to pay £1973 for a direct flight. Would happily have had vaccination if I’d been properly informed.
reviews.author: Jimmy G

reviews.title: Completely Unhelpful
reviews.text: Noticed an error on the booking, this was my fault - but I noticed 1/2/23. I got in touch as they are able to make changes within a 48hr timescale, I was happy to pay a fee to make the change. I heard nothing back and chased up again and again..it was now a week before the flight and they had still not be able to make the change. After further phone calls a couple of days prior to being told it was all in hand, I decided to buy another ticket just in case... Good job I did as the correction was never made and we wouldn't have been able to fly. Next problem - arrived at the destination and instantly received an email saying all return flights are cancelled as the flight wasn't checked in to. So I'm now back on the phone when I'm supposed to be enjoying my time away. I'm reassured there's no need to worry, again it's lies. Time to check in and the seat I've bought and paid for (I also paid extra for seat selection) has been cancelled. I'm told it's their policy- but I've not received a refund for the seat that has been paid for in advance in full, alongside a further seat I had to buy as the airline couldn't possibly make a change to the ticket with 18 days notice, despite the t&cs stating it can be done in just 2-5 days. £300 extra for the ticket and £150 flight seat cancelled. The most Unhelpful airline I've ever had to deal with, will definitely never use them again. They act like they want to help, they even pretend they're helping, but they don't so they can sell the seat and you have to buy an extra seat. Use another airline!
reviews.author: Jake J

reviews.title: The worst airline in Europe please read the description.
reviews.text: I am writing this message to express my most unpleasant travel experience with Brussels airline today. They claim to be the best European airline but my experience was quite opposite. Most of their customers not friendly and no one seemed to care. Yes, this was the worst flight I have ever taken in my life and it is unlikely I will ever fly with Brussels airline again. The worst airline in Europe, so I have booked my tickets from Manchester to Brussels for few days to work and visit Brussels City and I have paid massive amount of money. I went for a mission and I have purchased my tickets and paid almost £300 tickets, so i went to Brussels but my mission finished two days earlier and I thought like let me go back home to the UK and for that two days they charged me £160 for amendment for two days earlier, I understand that they charge some fee like £20-£30 but charging £160 is way too much, when I rang them and explained them, they seems nobody care and not listening to what I was saying. I will recomend to avoid this rubish airline. Please use another airline wich you can trust. They charged me three time from normal tickets and we had to bear extra cost.
reviews.author: Haqmal Attayee

reviews.title: Another sufficient short flight between Brussels and Frankfurt
reviews.text: Recently traveled to Brussels from Hong Kong which included a first leg flight between Brussels and Frankfurt as part of our return home. Check-in queue at Brussels was long first thing in the morning but the line moved quickly enough. Our bags were checked in and we were ticketed expediently. Plane was full, departed on time and arrived in Frankfurt when expected. As it was just a 40 minute flight, no drinks or snacks were served and no entertainment available. Overall, it was a short, simple flight that went as smoothly as likely possible. We had no real issues with this leg of our return flight with Brussels Airline and wouldn't have a problem flying with them again based on this experience.
reviews.author: Brad 🇭🇰

reviews.title: My second review in a week (return trip)
reviews.text: So this is for my return flight on Brussels Airlines. My flight back form JFK turned into a nightmare. Not due to Brussels Airlines, but the was an electrical fire at JFK T1 that closed down the entire terminal. Brussels Airlines changed my ticket immediately from JFK-BRU to JFK-BCN-BRU. the JFK-BCN was a Delta flight (not so good and reviewed this flight separately) and had Brussels Airlines from BCN-BRU. So rating the BCN-BRU flight here. The aircraft arrived on time and turnaround was done promptly. We boarded just 10 minutes later than normal and well organized. The aircraft pulled back on time and was a Boeing a319. Fly in business class; rows one and two and was seated in 2A. Seat normal with middle seat left open as usual. Flight stewards were attentive and even addressed you by your name; nice touch. The aircraft arrived 5 minutes ahead of schedule. Overall an enjoyable flight. There was a strike at the airport by Avia Partners (luggage handlers) so passengers could not get their checked luggage. I had hand carry items only, never trust Brussels airport, but this has nothing to do with the airline itself.
reviews.author: Mark C-

reviews.title: Worst possible experience flying with Brussels Airlines
reviews.text: Stuck on the plane for 8 hours and given little food (a packet of cashew nuts to share with my pregnant partner) and a couple of cups of water. Cancelled our return flight and forced us to remain on the outbound flight after being stuck there all day without communication. I have since raised a refund request following the proceedure given in November 2022 and contiunue to recieve automated responses that they are too busy to help us right now. I would never fly with this airline again at present and would not reccomend to anyone unless forced to use this company or its group.
reviews.author: jam

reviews.title: Change out of aircraft
reviews.text: I picked my seat so far in advance, know that I would be on an a330 in seat 5K. This is a single seat. I took this seat since I was traveling alone and would give me privacy to work utilising the Wi-Fi on board. One week before, I checked the seating and see it is changed instead of the original configuration the seating turned into 5 rows of 2x2x2. Upon boarding, I see the switch out is to a Eurowings a330. I do not mind that and as well having someone sitting next to me, but no Wi-Fi, so difficult to work. As well as smaller seats. Please upgrade your aircraft so that they are all the same for Buisness passengers. Good part, the flight attendents were outstanding.
reviews.author: Mark C-

reviews.title: Typical average European airline, nothing special, apart from friendly service
reviews.text: Check-in - good / Lounge - good / Boarding good / seats -average to uncomfortable / personnel - professional and friendly / Entertainment selection - poor to very poor terrible selection / Food was terrible choice of two meals chicken with a rich sugary sauce or Vegan (which I am not). Declined my meal and had a roll and cheese spread instead. Considering I have been flying the airline x 3 into Africa the last months, this is the way to lose customers. If there was one thing that put Brussels Airlines above all other European airlines, it was their excellent food! I am afraid not any longer!! On my return flight to Brussels, the "breakfast" consisted of a sugary pastry, that was it... . If I compare with Turkish, no comparison and I talking economy class. Budget cutting on food is not the right thing to do! Good luck Brussels Airlines.... I am heading straight back to Turkish or Emirates.... night and day!

reviews.text: All went smooth, still respect for priority and so. Friendly crew, except one but let's forget it. On the way back arrival at pier B, so with bus to pier A but also that went very smooth. Very clean.

reviews.title: Very pleasant and comfy flight
reviews.text: An evening flight SN2103 from Brussels to London Heathrow on 05 Feb was probably the best one I’ve ever flown with Brussels Airlines. Boarding was quick, both departure and arrival at LHR were on time, flight attendants were very polite and attentive. Even though no free snacks were served, it was not a problem since the service itself was great. I will be more than happy to fly with Brussels Airlines in the future.

reviews.title: Don't believe the help center of Sn Brussels airlines
reviews.text: I booked a trip from the Brudssels Airline site, to go to Rio De Janeiro. • Departure on 29/01  In Business class. • Return on 04/02  In economy class because business class was full. However, last weekend, I faced a health problem and went to the clinic emergency department on 01/24. Regarding the trip, they advised me to follow up during the week and I made an appointment with my doctor for 3 check-ups, the last for Saturday January 28 at 9 a.m. On Friday January 27, I contacted the SN Brussels Airlines helpdesk to explain the problem to them. I was told that it was possible to change the travel dates for a fee of €250, if I let them know on Saturday 01/28 the latest. On 28/01, given the state of healing, the doctor advised me not to travel and gave me a medical certificate.. On Saturday 01/28 at 2:43 p.m. I called the company's assistance service and asked the operator to change the date of the ticket to November 19 -2023 with a return depending on the possibilities between December 01 and 03, 2023 . I requested a return to business class as well. The agent made me several schedule proposals and I chose December 01 for the return. He asked me twice for my agreement to charge me the costs amounting to €250 + €5.20 for the change and gave my agreement. Then, I asked him to book me the business class tickets for all the flights. The agent put me on hold to perform the operation. He came back and told me, that he could not give me the fare for the return in business class, that he must first book the same flight plan as the original, namely, to go in business class and return to economy class. And afterwards, I should ask for an upgrade to business class for the return, I asked him the amount for this operation. He put me on hold and when he came back said that his system did not give him the possibility to see this option. Tired of going around in circles, I asked him to cancel the return flights in economy even it would only cost me 1000/1500€ and to modify the fare as provided for, the outward flight in business class and to sell me business class tickets for the return. The agent put me on hold again and a few minutes later told me that he couldn't get there as his system was hanging. He therefore asked me to go to the SN Brussels Airlines website, to proceed with the cancellation, to follow the instructions. That at the end of the process, the system will calculate the detailed fees and that two red tabs (I agree and I disagree) will appear on the screen allowing me to accept or refuse the cancellation and the fees. Then to contact their service again, to change the date of the outbound business class ticket and buy them a return business class ticket as well, or if the costs seem too high to me to accept their proposal to change the date but with the same flight plan. I went to the site, I proceeded as the agent explained to me, but at the last step, no details of the costs appeared, no encrypted quote, no I agree or disagree button. Instead of that , I got a message on the screen: We are unable to calculate and show the cost live, are you sure to cancel, if ye, please continue and an email will be sent to you with the details. A few minutes later, I received an email, telling me that a refund of 85€ per passenger was going to be made to my account, even though the cost of the flights amounts to more than 5000€. I immediately called SN Brussels Airlines, as it was getting complicated and by 5 times I chose the French option, but each time I had an agent telling me that only English was possible. I even pointed out that we were in Belgium and that by law they had to offer me support in one of the national languages, but they didn't care. Finally I accepted English and the agent, after he put me again on hold, he told me that if my outward flight was in business class and therefore modifiable and refundable, the return in economy was not. reviews.title: Cancelled flight, lost and damaged baggage! Horrible!
reviews.text: I have never written a review before but I have to warn you all. If you can, avoid Brussels airlines. I fly from time to time and have never had such bad experience. Our flight was cancelled, ok, that happens, but the way the Brussels airlines communicated with us at the airport was terrible (they actually didn´t communicate at all). The whole situation was somehow handled by airport stuff. Our suitcase was lost on our way home and was delivered one day later but broken! I filed a complaint and it´s been more than a month and nobody got back with me. As I´m reading the reviews here, I´m glad that we even arrived home :-(.
reviews.author: Alena B

reviews.title: Brussels Air, & Delayed Baggae Non-Delivery in Kigali
reviews.text: Unfortunately, two of our five bags did not arrive with us on the flight from Brussels to Kigali. The (relatively) good news was that they arrived on the next day's Brussels Air flight. The bad news was that the Brussels Air office in Kigali required us to return to the airport to pick them up instead of being delivered to our residence. We have NEVER had such an experience of non-service! We were still in Kigali and it was "only" a significant inconvenience, but what if we were elsewhere in the country? The Kigali office told us "take it up with Brussels" and, three weeks after the event, we are still waiting for an explanation from Brussels Air management.
